Octave version: 11.3.0

```{octave}
% Set up environment
clear all;

%% Avoid throwing warning by loading the "statistics" package:
warning('off', 'Octave:shadowed-function');

%% Load packages:
pkg load statistics
pkg load io


% Read in data:
raw       = csv2cell('dat/Paired-Samples t-test/pairedttest_R_Protzko.csv');
var_names = raw(1, :);
data      = cell2struct(raw(2:end, :), var_names, 2);

% Select variables
RightMyth       = [data.RightMyth]';
RightProcedural = [data.RightProcedural]';

[sig, p_value, ci, stats] = ttest(RightMyth, RightProcedural)
```
